name: Vault Shield Hall
player_description: The left passage opens into a hall lined with shield-shapes carved in relief along the walls. Roman shields mixed with older Germanic patterns. At the far end, a stone plinth stands empty. Dust outlines show something rested here recently.
gm_notes: Hidden alcove: DC 14 Investigation or DC 12 Perception (passive if moving slowly) -- a loose stone in the east wall. Behind it: a wax tablet with a warning in Germanic, a carved OTHALAN rune token, and a partial copy of the binding contract. Three-clue rule: this is clue 1 of 3 for the contract's existence. DC 13 History: the shield carvings mix Roman and Germanic iconography in a way that suggests the space was used by both cultures before the Romans arrived.
